title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Actively Participating in the Clearing of Enterprise "Triangular Debts" in Economic Trial Work
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Actively Participating in the Economic Trial Work of Clearing Up Enterprise "Triangular Debts"

Fa (Jing) Fa [1991] No. 24

All local people's courts at various levels, all military courts at various levels, all railway transport intermediate courts and basic courts, and all maritime courts:

In recent years, the problem of enterprises defaulting on payments to each other has become a prominent issue affecting the normal operation of the national economy. In order to invigorate large and medium-sized state-owned enterprises and improve economic efficiency, the State Council has decided to make clearing up "triangular debts" a breakthrough. After deciding to take Liaoning Province as a pilot area for clearing up "triangular debts," it recently issued the "Notice on Rectifying the Order of Commodity Transactions and Strictly Enforcing Settlement Discipline" (Guo Fa [1991] No. 39). To ensure the smooth progress of socialist economic construction, people's courts at all levels should fully leverage the functional role of economic trials and actively participate in the work of clearing up "triangular debts." The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows:

1. People's courts in all localities shall strengthen their connection with local government leading groups for clearing up "triangular debts," fully leverage the functional role of economic trials, and ensure the smooth progress of the work of clearing up "triangular debts."

2. With respect to issues that need to be resolved through litigation procedures during the debt clearance process, if a party initiates a lawsuit in a people's court that has jurisdiction over the case, the court shall promptly file the case and conduct the trial expeditiously. In particular, for cases involving key links in the debt chain or key targets of debt clearance, efforts shall be concentrated to give them priority in trial and enforcement according to law, so as to achieve the effect of loosening one link and relaxing the entire chain.

3. Strictly adjudicate cases in accordance with the law. For parties who violate economic contracts and unreasonably default on payments, their liability for breach of contract shall be pursued according to law, ensuring that the party violating settlement discipline gains no economic advantage, and effectively overcoming the tendency of "defaulting is justified and profitable."

4. Where a bank handling settlement violates the provisions of the "Measures for Bank Settlement" by unilaterally refusing payment or returning negotiable instruments, failing to transfer funds when the payer's account has sufficient funds, or delaying, misappropriating, or intercepting settlement funds, thereby affecting the use of funds by customers and other banks, and the right holder initiates a lawsuit in a people's court, the responsible bank shall be ordered to compensate according to law in accordance with Article 24 of the "Measures for Bank Settlement."

5. In conjunction with the clearance of "triangular debts," further improve enforcement work. For parties who have the ability to perform but fail to perform legally effective judgments or mediation statements issued by a people's court, compulsory enforcement shall be carried out according to law. Where a bank with which the person subject to enforcement maintains an account refuses to assist the people's court in transferring deposits, such conduct shall be handled in accordance with Article 103 of the "Civil Procedure Law."

6. In conjunction with case handling, explain the law on the basis of individual cases, promote the socialist economic legal system, educate enterprises to consciously abide by the law, strictly perform contracts, and maintain the socialist planned commodity economy order. In particular, focus on promoting the law in key industries and key targets of debt clearance, so that enterprises understand the importance of managing the economy according to law and the legal liability for failing to perform contracts, and learn to use legal means to protect their own lawful rights and interests.

August 15, 1991
